documentation.file_docstring:
Telemetry and Event Stream System

This module provides event tracking and streaming capabilities
for decoupling execution from learning.
inline_comments: Return events after the last processed timestamp
Sort by turn number if available
Count unique turn numbers (handles non-sequential turns)
member_docstrings: TelemetryEvent: Represents a single execution event.

EventStream: Manages the event stream for telemetry.
Uses a simple file-based append-only log
emit: Emit an event to the stream.
read_all: Read all events from the stream.

read_unprocessed: Read events that haven't been processed yet.
If last_processed_timestamp is None
clear: Clear all events from the stream (for testing).
get_last_timestamp: Get the timestamp of the last event in the stream.

get_signal_events: Get all signal events, optionally filtered by signal type.

Args:
    signal_typ
